title: Criticality Spectrometer Model
description: A domain-agnostic dependency model. Contains no case-specific semantics. Nodes, typed dependencies with identified requirement groups, group-targeted time-stamped alternatives, and an outcome definition. The engine reads only this schema; all domain content lives in instances.

dependencies.description: Requirement rules. Each says: for target to function, its requirement groups must be satisfied under logic. Each group has a stable id and an any_of list of interchangeable inputs (satisfied if any one functions). AND: every group must be satisfied. OR: at least one.

id.description: Stable identifier for this requirement group, unique within the target.

any_of.description: Interchangeable input node ids; group satisfied if any one functions.

alternatives.description: Group-targeted, time-stamped substitutes. Each says: the requirement group identified by (target, requirement_id) may be satisfied by replacement once tau >= activation_time, while replacement functions. A substitute satisfies ONLY that one identified group.

requirement_id.description: The id of the requirement group (within target) that this substitute satisfies.

outcome.description: What loss is measured. served_sinks (default, recommended): count sinks reachable from at least one source. ordered_served_sinks: served, with the qualifying path passing an ordered waypoint sequence.
